Mistress '''Tuval''' was a tutor of [[Diryk]], the second oldest son of [[Ethenielle Kirukon Materasu|Queen Ethenielle]] and [[Brys Noramaga|Prince Brys]] of Kandor. 

She is only mentioned in the New Spring {{ref/book|ns|22}} and The Wheel of Time Companion{{ref|{{twotc}}, Mistress Tuval}}.
